title: TokenStore set/get/clear round trip
scenario: New TokenStore. getToken('e1') is undefined and hasToken false. setToken('e1','a1') then getToken/hasToken. setToken('e1','a2') overwrites. clearToken('e1').
expected: Undefined before set; 'a1' then 'a2' after overwrite; hasToken true; after clearToken getToken is undefined and hasToken false.

source: src/api/tokenStore.ts: useTokenFrom, getToken, MAX_ALIAS_DEPTH; scripts/test-browser-oauth-login.cjs (single alias hop)
title: TokenStore alias chains, cycles and depth cap
scenario: useTokenFrom('b','a') with token on a resolves for b. Chain c->b->a resolves. Cycle x->y->x returns undefined. Chain of 11+ hops to a real token returns undefined (depth cap 10). setToken on an aliased env drops the alias.
expected: Alias chains resolve up to 10 hops; cycles and over-deep chains return undefined without hanging; a direct setToken on the borrower removes the alias.

title: TokenStore sessions hold refresh token and clear fully
scenario: setSession('e1',{accessToken,refreshToken,expiresAt}). Check getToken and getRefreshToken. Add an alias for e2->e1 and an in-flight refresh promise. clearSession('e1'), then repeat setup and call clearAll().
expected: Access and refresh tokens are returned after setSession; clearSession removes access token, refresh token and alias for that env only; clearAll empties tokens, aliases, session data and in-flight refreshes.

title: Refresh-in-flight registry shares one promise per environment
scenario: setRefreshInFlight('e1', p). getRefreshInFlight('e1') returns the same promise object; 'e2' returns undefined. clearRefreshInFlight('e1') then get again.
expected: Same promise instance returned for e1 (so concurrent 401s share one refresh), undefined for other envs and after clear.

title: GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN sentinel value is stable
scenario: Import GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN. setToken('repo', GIT_SOURCE_TOKEN) and read back. Assert the exported constant equals '__reltio-git-source__'.
expected: Sentinel round-trips through TokenStore unchanged and keeps its literal value, since tree and UX state compare against it to enter git mode.

title: SessionStore saves refresh token to secrets and tracks env list
scenario: Fake SecretStorage and Memento. saveRefreshToken('e1','r1') twice and saveRefreshToken('e2','r2'). Inspect secrets keys, loadRefreshToken, listEnvironments.
expected: Secrets contain 'reltio.refreshToken.e1' and '.e2'; listEnvironments returns ['e1','e2'] with no duplicate for repeated save; only the env name list (no token) is in the Memento.

title: SessionStore delete removes secret and env entry
scenario: Save tokens for e1 and e2, deleteRefreshToken('e1'), then delete an env that was never saved.
expected: e1 secret is gone and loadRefreshToken('e1') is undefined; listEnvironments is ['e2']; deleting an unknown env does not throw.

source: src/api/oauthCredentialsStore.ts: OAuthCredentialsStore save/load/has/delete, SSO tenant id
title: OAuthCredentialsStore per-env keys and partial-credential handling
scenario: Fake SecretStorage. saveClientCredentials('e1',{id,secret}); loadClientCredentials, hasClientCredentials. Store only a clientId for 'e2' directly in secrets. saveSsoTenantId('e1','t'). deleteClientCredentials('e1').
expected: Keys are reltio.oauth.<env>.clientId/clientSecret/ssoTenantId; e2 with a missing secret loads as undefined and has=false; delete removes all three keys for e1.

title: Credential resolution precedence: own pair, single shared pair, ambiguous
scenario: Stores: (a) env has own pair; (b) env has none but exactly one distinct pair exists elsewhere; (c) two distinct pairs elsewhere and none own; (d) no pairs at all. Call resolveOAuthCredentials and canLoginWithBrowser.
expected: (a) own pair wins; (b) shared pair reused; (c) undefined; (d) undefined; canLoginWithBrowser mirrors defined-ness.

title: Browser login eligibility map for the tree menu
scenario: Call computeBrowserLoginEligibility with [] and with env lists under single-shared-pair and multi-pair stores. Include two envs with identical pairs.
expected: Empty list returns empty Map; envs with own pairs are true; envs without are true only if exactly one distinct pair exists; identical pairs de-duplicate to one.

title: Authorization URL carries required OAuth parameters and encodes values
scenario: buildAuthorizationUrl({clientId:'id a',clientSecret:'s'},'sso tenant','st&1'). Parse with URL.
expected: Host is auth.reltio.com path /oauth/sso; params tenant_id, response_type=code, client_id, redirect_uri=http://localhost:8081, state are present and correctly percent-encoded; client secret never appears in the URL.

title: ssoCheck maps responses to sso/native and SSO_CHECK_FAILED errors
scenario: Stub global fetch: {status:'sso'}, {status:'native'}, HTTP 500, rejected fetch, and {status:'weird',error:'x'}. Call ssoCheck.
expected: Returns 'sso' / 'native' for the first two; the other three throw OAuthLoginError with code SSO_CHECK_FAILED; POST body has tenant_id, client_id, response_type=code, state, redirect_uri and no client_secret.

title: refreshTokens keeps old refresh token when server omits one
scenario: Stub fetch to return {access_token:'new',expires_in:60} without refresh_token; call refreshTokens('old',creds). Repeat with a new refresh_token and no expires_in. Inspect request headers/body.
expected: Session has accessToken 'new', refreshToken 'old', expiresAt about now+60s; second case uses returned refresh token and defaults to 3600s; request uses Basic auth and grant_type=refresh_token.

title: Refresh failure raises REFRESH_FAILED without leaking secrets
scenario: Stub fetch returning HTTP 400/401 for refreshTokens('old-refresh', creds with secret 'S3CRET').
expected: Throws OAuthLoginError code REFRESH_FAILED with message 'Token refresh failed: HTTP <status>'; message does not contain the refresh token, client secret or Basic header.

source: src/api/oauthLogin.ts: runBrowserLogin, startCallbackServer, exchangeCodeForTokens (http server on 8081, fetch and vscode.env.openExternal stubbed)
title: Browser login happy path exchanges the code and opens the auth URL
scenario: Stub ssoCheck fetch -> sso, stub openExternal to capture the URL, then GET http://localhost:8081/?code=C&state=<state from URL>. Stub token endpoint to return access/refresh tokens.
expected: Callback gets 200 success page; runBrowserLogin resolves an OAuthSession with the returned tokens and expiresAt in the future; token POST uses grant_type=authorization_code with the code and redirect_uri.

title: Callback with wrong state is rejected as possible CSRF
scenario: Start runBrowserLogin with stubs, then request /?code=C&state=WRONG on port 8081.
expected: Response is HTTP 400 with an error page; login rejects with OAuthLoginError STATE_MISMATCH; no token exchange fetch is made; state value is 32 hex chars (random per login).

source: src/api/oauthLogin.ts: buildCallbackErrorHtml escaping, callback with no code
title: Callback error page escapes content and missing code yields 400
scenario: Request /?state=x with no code on the callback server; inspect body. Also drive the state-mismatch page and check that markup characters in any message are rendered as entities.
expected: HTTP 400 with 'Login failed' page; message text is HTML-escaped (&, <, > replaced); login promise rejects; server closes after the single response.

title: Tenant without external IdP fails with NO_IDP_CONFIGURED before any listener opens
scenario: Stub ssoCheck fetch to return {status:'native'}; call runBrowserLogin. Then check that port 8081 is still free and openExternal was not called.
expected: Rejects with OAuthLoginError NO_IDP_CONFIGURED naming the tenant; no callback server started; browser not opened.

source: src/api/oauthLogin.ts: startCallbackServer EADDRINUSE, PORT_BUSY; exchangeCodeForTokens EXCHANGE_FAILED
title: Port conflict and failed code exchange map to typed errors
scenario: (a) Occupy port 8081 with a net server, then runBrowserLogin with sso stub. (b) Free port, deliver valid callback, stub token endpoint to return HTTP 401.
expected: (a) OAuthLoginError PORT_BUSY mentioning port 8081; (b) OAuthLoginError EXCHANGE_FAILED 'Token exchange failed: HTTP 401'. Neither message includes client secret or code.

title: Success page is self-contained and shows logo then message
scenario: Call buildCallbackSuccessHtml and inspect the HTML.
expected: Contains 'Login Successful!' heading, inline data: URI Reltio logo before the heading, no external image URL and no vscode:// or cursor:// links.

title: Terms gate prompts once, fails closed, and re-prompts on version bump
scenario: Existing script covers: first accept persists version and timestamp, decline/dismiss persist nothing, unreadable or blank terms fail closed, reset re-prompts. Add: stored older version (e.g. '0') triggers prompt again.
expected: Accept returns true and stores TERMS_VERSION; decline/dismiss/unreadable/blank return false with no state; already-accepted returns true with no modal; mismatched stored version prompts.

title: Setup wizard does not start when terms are declined
scenario: Stub ensureTermsAccepted path by using a context with no accepted version and a showWarningMessage stub returning 'Decline'. Call launchSetupWizard with spy deps. Assert createQuickPick and showInputBox are never called.
expected: Wizard returns without showing any step, creating an environment, or touching tokenStore/sessionStore/oauthCredentialsStore.

title: Wizard finish stores browser session: access token in memory, refresh token in SecretStorage
scenario: Drive stepConfirmAndFinish path with state {host, accessToken:'A', refreshToken:'R'} via launchSetupWizard stubs (or by exporting the step for test). Inspect TokenStore, SessionStore fake secrets, globalState/workspaceState/config writes.
expected: tokenStore.setSession called with access and refresh tokens; sessionStore saves only refresh token to secrets; access token 'A' appears in no secrets, Memento or configuration update. Paste-token path calls setToken only and saves nothing to sessionStore.

source: src/ux/setupWizard.ts: stepAuthSubflow catch block, OAuthLoginError codes
title: Failed browser login in wizard deletes saved credentials and returns to previous step
scenario: Credentials pre-saved for env; stub runBrowserLogin to throw NO_IDP_CONFIGURED, SSO_CHECK_FAILED and a generic Error in turn (via fetch/http stubs). Observe showErrorMessage calls and store contents.
expected: Each failure deletes the env's client credentials and SSO tenant id, shows a code-specific message (modal for the first two, plain 'Login failed:' otherwise), and the wizard goes back a step. Reviewer to confirm that wiping credentials on transient errors (e.g. PORT_BUSY) is intended.

source: src/ux/setupWizard.ts: launchSetupWizard step loop, stepAuthSubflow guard, stepFirstTenant skip/auto-add
title: Wizard step navigation: back, cancel, skip tenant, auto-added tenant
scenario: With stubbed quick picks/input boxes: cancel at step 2; choose 'Go back and modify inputs' at step 5; choose Skip at step 4; token path where oauthCredentialsStore has an SSO tenant id and autoAddSsoTenant returns a tenant.
expected: Cancel ends with no environment created; back re-runs step 4 (min step 1); skip finishes with env only and a hint message; auto-added tenant skips the step 4 picker and does not recreate the tenant on finish.

source: src/ux/setupGuidePanel.ts: renderErrorHtml, escapeText, escapeAttribute, openSetupGuidePanel (webview options); scripts/test-docs-light-theme-screenshots-and-setup-guide.cjs (reads resources/setupGuide.json only)
title: Setup guide panel: scripts disabled, single instance, error page on bad content
scenario: Using the vscode stub, call openSetupGuidePanel twice and capture createWebviewPanel options. Make fs.readFile throw or return invalid JSON and inspect webview.html.
expected: createWebviewPanel called once with enableScripts false and localResourceRoots limited to resources and codicons; second call reveals the existing panel; failure renders 'Could not load Setup Guide' with the error message HTML-escaped.

title: Path traversal guards on host, tenantId and tokenFile
scenario: isSafePathSegment on '', ' a', '.', '..', 'a..b', 'a/b', 'a\\b', 'a\0b', '361.reltio.com'. resolveTokenFileUri(root, ...) with '../x.json', 'a/../../x', absolute C:\\x.json, '/etc/x', '' and 'secrets/t.json'.
expected: Unsafe segments return false and valid host true; escaping, absolute and empty tokenFile values return {error}; 'secrets/t.json' resolves to a URI under the workspace root.

title: Inline secrets in defaultEnvironments are ignored and reported
scenario: Stub getConfiguration('reltio').get('defaultEnvironments') with an entry {host,tenantId,token:'abc',clientSecret:'x'} plus a tokenFile-less valid one. Run applyDefaultEnvironments with spy tokenStore and environmentManager.
expected: Environment and tenant are scaffolded, tokenStore.setToken is never called with 'abc', and result.errors contains a message listing the ignored field names (not their values).

title: Token file loading: valid, missing, invalid JSON, missing access_token
scenario: vscode.workspace.fs.readFile stub returns: {"access_token":" tok "}, throws, 'not json', '[]', {"access_token":""}. Call readAccessTokenFromFile and applyDefaultEnvironments with a tokenFile entry.
expected: Valid returns trimmed 'tok' and authenticated=1; the others return specific {error} strings (unreadable, not valid JSON, must be a JSON object, missing string access_token) and are added to result.errors without throwing.

title: Conflicting tokenFile entries per host are skipped; shared file binds many hosts
scenario: Entries: hostA with two different tokenFiles; hostB and hostC sharing one file. Call findConflictingTokenFiles, indexTokenFilesByCanonicalPath, then reloadTokenFileIntoStore with a stubbed readFile.
expected: hostA reported as conflict with sorted distinct paths and omitted from bindings; hostB+hostC produce one binding with sorted hosts; reload reads the file once and sets the same token on both hosts.

title: Apply defaults scaffolds idempotently and reports a summary
scenario: Stub config with two entries (same host, different tenants) and an environmentManager fake (scanEnvironments, createEnvironment, createTenant). Run apply twice; also run with empty list, with only invalid entries, and with a host containing '..'.
expected: First run: environment created once, two tenants created, scaffolded=3, callbacks fired; second run scaffolded=0; empty/invalid/unsafe cases return explanatory errors and create nothing; summarizeApplyResult lists counts and issues.

title: L3 fetch outcomes: written, 401, error
scenario: tokenFile entry with fetchL3 true; writeL3FromApi stub returns 'written', then '401', then 'error'.
expected: 'written' increments fetched; '401' adds 'token rejected (401)' message; 'error' adds 'Fetch Configuration failed.'; authenticated count is unaffected by the fetch result.

source: src/workspace/environmentManager.ts: environmentShortLabel, createEnvironment, createTenant, scanEnvironments, scanTenants; scripts/test-git-ready-tenant-folder-structure.cjs
title: EnvironmentManager create and scan round trip with identity markers
scenario: Existing script covers EnvironmentManager basics; propose adding a case using an in-memory vscode.workspace.fs stub: createEnvironment('dev.reltio.com'), createTenant(host,'t1'), scanEnvironments/scanTenants, environmentShortLabel('dev.reltio.com'), and a dot-prefixed folder.
expected: Folder uses short label 'dev' with a marker carrying the full host; scan returns the host (not 'dev') with tenant t1 hasL3 false; dotfolders like .reltio are skipped; results sorted.

source: src/workspace/environmentManager.ts: scanEnvironments (legacy .reltio.environment suffix and .reltio/ preference), removeTenant
title: Legacy suffixed folders are still discovered and removed correctly
scenario: Fs stub with workspace-root 'dev.reltio.com.reltio.environment/t1.reltio.tenant' and the same host also under '.reltio/'. scanEnvironments, then removeTenant('dev.reltio.com','t1').
expected: Host appears once, resolved from the preferred .reltio/ copy; legacy-only host is listed with tenant t1; removeTenant deletes the legacy suffixed directory, not a bare-named path.

title: Login times out if the browser callback never arrives
scenario: Manual QA (Tier C): start Sign in with browser from the tree, do not complete login in the browser, wait over 2 minutes. Then retry login immediately. Automated variant would need fake timers around setTimeout.
expected: After 120s an error 'Login timed out. Please try again.' appears, the localhost:8081 listener is released, and a second login attempt does not hit PORT_BUSY.
